answer: Each submission hangs on the spiral of a task receipt, and the ripple is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
